title: Profetanak taypin Llamp’u Alma
intro: Mä aruw chiqapar sarnaqañatak jawsañax Noble Corán ukan jisk’a t’aqanakapat ist’asi. Uka bendito almajj profecía ukat Diosan qellqatanakap churasïna, uka tiemponjja Israel Wawanakan irpañajj wal munaskäna. Uka jaqix markapampiw chiqak parläna, Tatitupat amtasipxañapatakiw chʼamañchtʼäna. Pacienciampi ukat Diosar katuyasisax mä qhanaruw tukupxäna, jupanakan sarnaqäwipax qullan qillqatanakan pankanakap qhant’ayi. ¿Aka muspharkañ jaqirux uñt’asmati, khititix sutipax Quran ukhamarak Evangelio ukanakan jach’añchatawa?
clues: Markajan jan waltʼäwin uñjasipkäna uka tiemponjja, profetjama ukat alajjpachankir mä librompiw jachʼañchatäyäta.
Mamajax wali muspharkañaw nayarux yuriwayitu, Allah-an Diosan kamachipampi sapakiw yuriwayitu.
Nayax markajarux akham sasaw arsta: ‘¡Israel wawanaka! Nayax jumanakar Allah-an khithanitätwa, kuntix nayrax jutkän uk chiqanchasa’ sasa.
Nayax Tatitumat qhana chimpunak apt’ataw jutta, mä profetat kusiskañ yatiyäwinak apanisa, jupax Ahmad sutinïniwa.
Mamajax chiqapar sarnaqir warminïnwa, waynäkasinx Allah-ar luqtañatakiw ch’amanchawayitu.
Allah jupax Quran yatichawayitu ukat mamajarux khuyapt’ayasiri ukat lurañanak lurarakitu, ukat janiw jach’a jach’a tukurïkti ni jan ist’asirïkti.

arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِنِّى رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ إِلَيْكُم مُّصَدِّقًۭا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَمُبَشِّرًۢا بِرَسُولٍۢ يَأْتِى مِنۢ بَعْدِى ٱسْمُهُۥٓ أَحْمَدُ ۖ فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ قَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَا سِحْرٌۭ مُّبِينٌۭ
verse: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, "O Children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of Allāh to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Aḥmad." But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, "This is obvious magic." (61:6)
